results.title: Soldier Field
results.snippet: Soldier Field offers a variety of unique hospitality spaces prior to or during major events to make your day even more special. From luxury suites, interior club spaces and historic areas to exterior terraces and parklands.

results.title: About - Soldier Field
results.snippet: Natural Turf Field The playing field at Soldier Field is a natural grass field (Kentucky blue-grass and rye blend). The field is resodded multiple times per year with consultation from the Chicago Bears and the Chicago Fire as it is the preferred surface for both football and soccer.
